name: Caravan Manufacturing
shortSummary: Locally manufactured, ADNOC-compliant portacabins — accommodation, office, mosque and ablution units, skid or trailer mounted.
body: MBF is a trusted name in oilfield equipment manufacturing in the local and regional markets. We are one of the few companies in the Middle East to have a certified, fully-integrated HSEQ management system in place, which carries through to every caravan we build.

Our local manufacturing facility produces customized portacabins in various sizes — offices, sleepers, mosques, security cabins and ablution units — fulfilling ADNOC requirements for quality and safety. Full product specifications for each caravan variant are listed in our equipment catalog.
Caravans are available for purchase outright or on a 12-month lease-to-own installment plan, priced per unit below.
